headlines.title: 楼市新政后A股房企首单再融资 保利发展拟发行50亿元定向可转债
headlines.summary: 今年8月底，证监会发布的《关于资本市场支持构建房地产发展新模式的意见》提到，支持上市房地产开发企业综合运用股份、定向可转债、现金等工具收购涉房资产，其中发行股份、定向可转债购买资产的，可以募集配套资金，并用于符合政策要求的房地产项目和支付本次重组交易对价等。近日，保利发展披露50亿元定向可转债募集说明书，成为此次房地产新政落地后，A股地产上市公司中首家启动再融资的上市房企。

headlines.title_en: First A-share real estate developer refinancing after new property policies: Poly Developments plans to issue 5 billion yuan in targeted convertible bonds
headlines.summary_en: At the end of August this year, the CSRC's "Opinions on Supporting the Construction of a New Model for Real Estate Development through the Capital Market" mentioned support for listed real estate development enterprises to comprehensively use tools such as shares, targeted convertible bonds, and cash to acquire real estate-related assets. Among these, those issuing shares or targeted convertible bonds to purchase assets may raise supporting funds and use them for real estate projects that meet policy requirements and to pay the consideration for the current restructuring transaction, among other purposes. Recently, Poly Developments disclosed a RMB 5 billion targeted convertible bond prospectus, becoming the first listed real estate developer on the A-share market to launch refinancing after this new real estate policy was implemented.

headlines.title: 新西兰8月房价下降 购房者观望致成交放缓
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月15日讯，新西兰房地产协会(REINZ)周二表示，新西兰8月房价下降，因生活成本上涨和就业市场低迷打击了购房者信心，促使潜在购房者采取观望态度。REINZ数据显示，8月经季节性调整后的房价中位数较7月下降1.3%，同比亦下降1.3%。全国房屋销量环比下降1.9%，同比降幅接近10%。REINZ首席执行官Lizzy Ryley表示，“与其说是价格出现明显波动，不如说市场节奏发生了变化，成交量减少，房产售出所需时间也更长。”房产售出所需时间中位数为51天，比2025年8月多3天，创下有记录以来8月第四高。

headlines.title_en: New Zealand house prices fell in August as buyers stayed on the sidelines, slowing transactions
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, September 15 — The Real Estate Institute of New Zealand (REINZ) said on Tuesday that New Zealand house prices fell in August as rising living costs and a sluggish job market hit homebuyer confidence, prompting potential buyers to take a wait-and-see approach. REINZ data showed that the seasonally adjusted median house price fell 1.3% in August from July and also fell 1.3% year-on-year. National home sales fell 1.9% month-on-month, with a year-on-year decline of nearly 10%. REINZ Chief Executive Lizzy Ryley said, "Rather than sharp price fluctuations, what has changed is the pace of the market, with fewer transactions and homes taking longer to sell." The median time to sell a property was 51 days, 3 days more than in August 2025, the fourth-highest on record for August.

headlines.title_en: In the first eight months, outstanding social financing grew 7.2% year on year, with direct financing accounting for more than half of the increment
headlines.summary_en: [Outstanding Social Financing Up 7.2% YoY in First Eight Months; Direct Financing Accounts for More Than Half of the Increase] On September 14, the People's Bank of China released its August 2026 financial statistics report. Data showed that at the end of August, the stock of social financing was RMB 464.8 trillion, up 7.2% year-on-year, and the broad money (M2) balance was RMB 356.81 trillion, up 7.5% year-on-year, both higher than nominal GDP growth. The reporter noted that in the first eight months, the share of direct financing increases such as bonds and equities exceeded that of loans.

headlines.title: China’s inbound tourism revenue projected to reach US$470 billion by 2040: UBS
headlines.summary:
Revenue from inbound travel to China is forecast to reach US$470 billion by 2040, more than doubling its current share of the economy and helping offset weak domestic demand, according to UBS.
Tourism from outside mainland China would expand to 1.5 per cent of gross domestic product (GDP) on a compound annual growth rate of 8.9 per cent from 2025, the Swiss investment bank estimated.
China’s inbound travel revenue would represent 15 per cent of the world tourism market by around 2040, said Chen...
headlines.title_zh: 瑞银：预计到2040年中国入境旅游收入将达到4700亿美元
headlines.summary_zh:
瑞银预计，到2040年，中国入境旅游收入将达4700亿美元，占经济比重较当前水平翻倍以上，有助于抵消国内需求疲软。
根据瑞银的数据，来自中国大陆以外的旅游收入将占国内生产总值（GDP）的1.5%，从2025年起的复合年增长率为8.9%。

headlines.title: 央行开展5000亿元6个月期买断式逆回购操作
headlines.summary: 【央行开展5000亿元6个月期买断式逆回购操作】9月14日，中国人民银行公告显示，为保持银行体系流动性充裕，2026年9月15日，将以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展5000亿元买断式逆回购操作，期限为6个月（181天），到期日为2027年3月15日（遇节假日顺延）。

headlines.title_en: PBOC conducts 500 billion yuan 6-month outright reverse repo operation
headlines.summary_en: [PBOC Conducts RMB 500 Billion 6-Month Outright Reverse Repurchase Operation] On September 14, the People's Bank of China announcement showed that, in order to keep liquidity in the banking system ample, on September 15, 2026, it will conduct a RMB 500 billion outright reverse repurchase operation through fixed quantity, interest rate bidding, and multiple-price allotment, with a term of 6 months (181 days) and a maturity date of March 15, 2027 (postponed in case of holidays).

headlines.title: 报道：特朗普想与黄仁勋讨论AI
headlines.summary: 在洛杉矶“All-In Summit”峰会的舞台上，英伟达CEO黄仁勋现场接听了美国总统特朗普的电话。通话期间，特朗普将人工智能（AI）带来的危险称为“骗局”。 特朗普批评了试图放缓AI发展步伐的呼声，称这“恰恰让许多不想看到AI发展的人得逞”，并认为这种呼声可能是由政客或中国推动的。 黄仁勋赞同特朗普的观点，但也赞扬了一位因担忧AI风险而辞职的Anthropic PBC研究员，并表示组织内部应严肃对待吹哨人的声音。（纽约时报）

headlines.title_en: Report: Trump wants to discuss AI with Jensen Huang
headlines.summary_en: On the stage of the "All-In Summit" in Los Angeles, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang took a live phone call from U.S. President Trump. During the call, Trump called the dangers brought by artificial intelligence (AI) a "scam." Trump criticized calls to slow the pace of AI development, saying this "precisely plays into the hands of many people who do not want to see AI develop," and argued that such calls may be pushed by politicians or China. Huang agreed with Trump's view, but also praised an Anthropic PBC researcher who resigned over concerns about AI risks, and said whistleblowers' voices should be taken seriously within organizations. (The New York Times)

headlines.title: 业内人士：美联储加息箭在弦上，A股后市把握三类投资机遇
headlines.summary: 多位业内人士认为，美联储或在9月开启预防型加息，短期内对市场扰动有限，且美联储当前也缺乏持续大幅加息的基础；对A股而言，产业层面的变化将成为下一阶段市场的运行主线，在宏观压制性因素落地后，市场有望逐渐重回上行区间。在行业配置上，建议重点关注AI算力链、资源品涨价等方向机遇。此外，看好银行、保险等红利板块，以及有望受益于高油价的油气开采、油服工程等板块。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Industry insiders: Fed rate hikes are imminent, A-shares should seize three types of investment opportunities going forward
headlines.summary_en: Many industry insiders believe that the Federal Reserve may start a preventive rate hike in September, with limited short-term disruption to the market, and that the Fed currently lacks the basis for continued large rate hikes. For A-shares, changes at the industrial level will become the main line of market operation in the next stage, and after macro restrictive factors land, the market is expected to gradually return to an upward range. In terms of industry allocation, it is recommended to focus on opportunities in directions such as the AI computing power chain and rising resource prices. In addition, they are bullish on dividend sectors such as banks and insurance, as well as sectors such as oil and gas exploration and oilfield services engineering that are expected to benefit from high oil prices. (China Securities Journal)
